steps.subject: sky
steps.action: paint circles and patterns in the sky
steps.load: tapped yellow ochre and dark sienna on the brush
steps.motion: circles going one way, then the other

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add a bright white spot and bounce it around
steps.load: a little pure white on the brush
steps.motion: bounce the white around with the corner

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: paint soft far bushes with the corner of the brush
steps.load: lavender lightly tapped on the brush corner
steps.motion: tap basic shapes in the back
steps.rule: too much detail up close makes far shapes look close

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: flick paint thinner onto the paint for leaf dots
steps.load: paint thinner on the brush corner
steps.motion: flick the thinner onto the paint
steps.rule: thinner lifts paint, leaving dots that read as leaves

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add yellow ochre and dark sienna shapes in front of the lavender bushes
steps.load: yellow ochre and dark sienna mixed
steps.motion: shape small things in layers
steps.where: in front of the lavender bushes

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add indian yellow and lavender bush variety
steps.load: indian yellow dabbed, then lavender on without cleaning
steps.motion: work back and forth so colors mix

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add a touch of cadmium yellow to brighten the spot
steps.motion: dab a brighter spot
steps.rule: cadmium is strong, so use only a tiny amount

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin sticks and branches in lavender
steps.load: lavender thinned with paint thinner, turned to a point
steps.motion: paint thin branches and twigs
steps.where: back in the layers, behind the bushes

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add a touch of dark sienna and van dyke to the trees on the other side
steps.load: least touch of dark sienna added
steps.motion: paint the trees on the other side

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add a few white sticks and twigs
steps.motion: dab a few white sticks here and there
steps.rule: white sticks are common in woods, so add some

steps.subject: other: shadow base
steps.action: lay a lavender base low down on the clear
steps.motion: lay color down low

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: lay pure white snow from the back toward the top
steps.motion: lay snow with the brush
steps.where: from the back area up toward the top

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: mix and push weeds up with the fan brush
steps.load: mixed a variety on the brush, a little white added
steps.motion: push upward for little weeds

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: clean snow edges with white on a fan
steps.motion: grab and pull to clean the edges

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add lavender sticks and twigs
steps.motion: add sticks and twigs
steps.where: out in the snow and up closer

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in the cabin back eave, then snow on the roof
steps.load: brown on the knife, then white on the knife
steps.motion: lay the back eave, then the other side of the roof

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in cabin front with van dyke brown
steps.motion: touch and pull for base color

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add old wood texture with a marbled mix
steps.motion: touch and pull down with no pressure
steps.rule: no pressure lets the paint break so the wood looks old

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: lay in a door and a window in van dyke brown
steps.motion: lay in the door and window shapes

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: outline the window with light color
steps.motion: outline the window so it stands out

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: bring snow up to the cabin door with the fan
steps.motion: pull the snow up to the door

steps.subject: path
steps.action: indicate a small path with dark lavender
steps.load: a touch of the dark lavender
steps.motion: make a small indication going up

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap bushes on this side with dark sienna and yellow ochre
steps.motion: tap the indication of bushes
steps.where: on this side near the cabin
steps.rule: few people around means the deer can stay

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add yellow ochre, indian yellow, and cadmium yellow bushes
steps.load: yellow ochres and a little white on the brush
steps.motion: tap in bushes with the top corner
steps.where: the other side of the cabin

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add a snow bank with white
steps.motion: touch and push snow in
steps.where: beside the bushes near the cabin

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap little grassy areas with the fan
steps.motion: tap little grass

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: clean the bottom edge with white on a fan
steps.motion: clean up the bottom

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint a big tree in van dyke brown and dark sienna
steps.motion: drop in the big tree shape

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap a highlight along the tree edge with mostly white
steps.load: mostly white with a little dark sienna
steps.motion: tap along the edge

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint big limbs with thin browns
steps.load: browns thinned like ink with paint thinner
steps.motion: reach out thin limbs and arms

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add sticks and twigs hanging off the tree
steps.motion: hang sticks and twigs off the limbs

rules: [12:09] thinner reacting with the clear makes marks look highlighted
[25:29] tapping makes edges look fuzzy, like evergreen bark
